login.heading: sign in
login.intro: Enter the admin password configured as ADMIN_PASSWORD on this server.

session.endedMessage: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on where you left off.
session.confirmMessage: Erasing views permanently cannot be undone. Enter your password to continue.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Slow down for a moment and try again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The request was refused for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Enter your password again to continue.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The server did not accept that input.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.ACCESS_EXPIRED: Your sign-in to the site's access gateway (for example Cloudflare Access) has ended. Reload the page to sign in there again.
errors.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong in this page. Reload it and try again.

appTabs.label: Apps
appTabs.unavailable: The table for {app} is missing on the database server.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search page, title, site, source, campaign, note, event, or view ID…

limit.one: At most {count} view can be selected at once.
limit.other: At most {count} views can be selected at once.

table.selectPage: Select every view on this page
table.columnsIntro: Tick the columns you want, and put them in order of importance. The table shows as many as fit its width, in this order; the rest of each row is one tap away, under it. Drag a column's edge in the table to change its width.
table.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Arrow keys also work, and Enter or a double click resets it.

views.intro: Every view and event the tracker recorded, one row each, newest first. These rows are what every number on the Overview is computed from. Correct a row, add a private note, or move it to the trash; every change is recorded in the Admin log.

retention.one: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. They are erased permanently {count} day after being deleted, or sooner if you erase them here.
retention.other: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. They are erased permanently {count} days after being deleted, or sooner if you erase them here.

trash.retentionOff: Views in the trash no longer count in any statistic. Automatic erasure is off (TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS=0), so they stay until erased here.
trash.intro: Views moved to the trash. They no longer count in any statistic and can be restored, or erased for good. Erasing asks for your password again.

editedPartial.one: Edited {count} view; {skipped} skipped because they are in the trash or gone.
editedPartial.other: Edited {count} views; {skipped} skipped because they are in the trash or gone.

noteSavedPartial.one: Saved the note on {count} view; {skipped} no longer exist.
noteSavedPartial.other: Saved the note on {count} views; {skipped} no longer exist.

noteClearedPartial.one: Cleared the note on {count} view; {skipped} no longer exist.
noteClearedPartial.other: Cleared the note on {count} views; {skipped} no longer exist.

deletedPartial.one: Moved {count} view to the trash; {skipped} were already there.
deletedPartial.other: Moved {count} views to the trash; {skipped} were already there.

restoredPartial.one: Restored {count} view; {skipped} were not in the trash.
restoredPartial.other: Restored {count} views; {skipped} were not in the trash.

purgedPartial.one: Erased {count} view permanently; {skipped} were not in the trash.
purgedPartial.other: Erased {count} views permanently; {skipped} were not in the trash.

deleteMessage.one: It stops counting in every statistic at once. You can restore it from the trash within {days} days, after which it is erased for good.
deleteMessage.other: They stop counting in every statistic at once. You can restore them from the trash within {days} days, after which they are erased for good.

deleteMessageNoRetention.one: It stops counting in every statistic at once. You can restore it from the trash at any time.
deleteMessageNoRetention.other: They stop counting in every statistic at once. You can restore them from the trash at any time.

purgeMessage.one: This removes the view from the database for good. It cannot be restored. The admin log keeps a record that it was erased, but none of its content.
purgeMessage.other: This removes the views from the database for good. They cannot be restored. The admin log keeps a record that they were erased, but none of their content.

edit.introSingle: Change a field and it is saved. The view is then marked as modified by an admin.

introBatch.one: Tick each field to overwrite on the selected view. Unticked fields are left alone.
introBatch.other: Tick each field to overwrite on all {count} selected views. Unticked fields are left alone.

edit.lockedNotice: What was observed about the visitor (time, masked IP, country, browser, device type) can never be edited. The source is recalculated from the referrer.
edit.nothingSelected: Choose at least one field to change.

note.intro: A private annotation for admins. Adding a note does not mark a view as modified.

logs.adminIntro: Everything done in this admin: sign-ins, edits, notes, moves to the trash, restores, and erasures, with the session and the masked address it came from. It never records what a view said, so an erased view leaves no trace of its content.
logs.trackingIntro: Every tracking request that reached the server, and what became of it. Views lists only what was recorded, and the Overview counts only that. This log also shows what was never stored: bots, and requests refused (an unregistered site, an unknown app, a malformed request). Use it to check that a site is sending views and to find out why some are not counted. Editing or deleting a view never changes it.

trackingRetention.one: Entries are removed automatically {count} day after they are recorded. Views are not affected.
trackingRetention.other: Entries are removed automatically {count} days after they are recorded. Views are not affected.

logs.trackingRetentionOff: Entries are kept until removed by hand (VIEW_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=0).

outcomeHelp.recorded: Stored as a view, and counted as a unique view.
outcomeHelp.repeat: Stored as a view, from a visitor already counted in this window, so not counted as unique.
outcomeHelp.bot: A crawler, preview fetcher, or automated browser. Never stored; counted here by name, per minute.
outcomeHelp.rejected: Refused and never stored; the reason is shown. Counted per minute, without anything about the requester.

summaryLabel.one: Tracking requests in the last {count} hour
summaryLabel.other: Tracking requests in the last {count} hours

logs.noReasons: Nothing refused in the last day.

charts.trendLabel: {metric} from {from} to {to}, highest at {peak} on {peakAt}. Use the arrow keys to read each period.
charts.mapLabel: World map of views by country, {countries} countries with views. The list beside it gives the numbers.
charts.mapUnavailable: The map could not be loaded. The list beside it has every number.
charts.heatmapLabel: Views by weekday and hour, busiest on {day} at {hour} with {views} views. Use the arrow keys to read each hour, or switch to the table.
charts.minutesLabel: Views per minute over the last {count} minutes, {views} in all. Use the arrow keys to read each minute.

overview.intro: Statistics for the app and period chosen below, computed from live views only (the trash never counts). Click any row in a breakdown to narrow everything to it.
overview.tilesLabel: Headline numbers. Choose one to chart it over time.

span.one: From {from} to {to} · {countries} country · {unique} unique views · {modified} changed by an admin
span.other: From {from} to {to} · {countries} countries · {unique} unique views · {modified} changed by an admin

help.visitors: Distinct visitors, told apart by a hash of the address and browser that changes every day and is never stored with anything that identifies a person. The same person on two days counts twice, and people sharing a network and browser count once.
help.visits: Page views of one visitor with no pause longer than 30 minutes between them.
help.pageviews: Views of a page, without custom events.
help.views: Everything recorded: page views and custom events such as downloads or clicks on links to other sites.
help.bounceRate: The share of visits that saw only one page.
help.avgVisitMs: From the first page view of a visit to the last, plus how long the last page was visible. The average over visits.
help.pagesPerVisit: Page views per visit, on average.
help.avgEngagedMs: How long a page was actually visible on screen, as the tracker script measured it. Only pages with a measurement count.
help.avgScroll: How much of a page had been on screen, at most, as the tracker script measured it.

overview.noVisits: No page views, so no visits, match these filters.
overview.noFlow: No visitor went from one page to another in these views.
overview.noProperties: No custom event carried properties in these views.
overview.noEngagement: No time or scrolling measured yet. The tracker script measures both; a site that registers views another way does not.
overview.noCityData: Regions and cities need a city database on the server (GEOIP_CITY_DB). Countries work without one.
overview.whenNote: Covers up to the last year of the chosen period, in your time zone.

live.title: Right now
live.nobody: Nobody on the sites right now.
live.updated: Updated {time}, every {seconds} s while this page is open. Live views of the chosen app; the filters above do not apply.
